title: Montserrat
text: Excellent guide!! Ride the funicular up and walk down, it's ideal. Sunscreen and water will be necessary.
author: Christian_L

title: Amazing experience!
text: We did this private tour to celebrate my husband's birthday and it was an excellent decision. Montserrat is truly magical and Vladi was an exceptional guide: professional, friendly and very attentive to every detail. Since before the tour he helped me organize a special day and everything went terrific. We definitely recommend it if you are looking for a personalized and well-kept experience.
author: Gabriela_D

title: Vladi a mountain pro
text: Vladi is a mountain guide who listens to his customers. He offered us a route that was well suited to our abilities. We appreciated that he spoke as well as he could in French. It is of great punctuality and ensures the comfort of its customers. I absolutely recommend
author: Marie_G

title: Fantastic Experience!
text: We had an amazing day hiking Montserrat with Vladi! We started the day with Vladi picking us up from our hotel, then  visiting the Basilica and the Black Madonna, next took the funicular up to start our hike. Vladi is an expert in the trails, flora, history and importance of Montserrat. We reached a peak with a 360 degree spectacular view. We enjoyed a picnic Vladi had brought. There was enough time to explore the market with handmade food items. We were returned back to our hotel. This experience was worth every penny, and o highly recommend to anyone!
author: Beth_B

title: Must-do Monserrat Hike
text: We did the moderate hike and it was perfect. Lots of different terrain, different types of paths and stairs…  We started from monastery and did a loop to the top and  back. Uphill was mainly trails and rock paths to the top and the descent was mostly stairs for the way we went. David, our guide, was amazing. Very knowledgeable and engaging, and allowed us to move at the pace we needed ( 3 teenagers leading the pack and us trailing behind). He gave us lots of interesting information about the history, geography and ecology of the area. At the top, we were provided with a light snack and lots of
author: Suzanne_M

title: Montserrat Hiking Adventure
text: Our tour guide (Valdi Ribo) was incredible! He is passionate about hiking and extremely fit. He led us on a hike at Monserrat up Sant Jeroni. He was very knowledgable about the history of the monastery and area. We hope to return some day for him to guide us through a hike in the Pyrenees!
author: denise_p

title: Don’t miss Monserrat hiking tour with Pere
text:
All the tour was spectacular, full of amazing views. Our guide Pere was very professional, experienced and initiative. He gave us a lot of information, did an express guiding in the museum (although it was not in a program).
We appreciate his efforts and time
author: Tatiana_M

title: Amazing Montserrat hike!
text: Pere was our guide for our Montserrat hike, he was amazing!  Very knowledgeable of the mountain and local history/lore.  The hike was wonderful, we had a great day!
author: 546rufusc

title: Great day hiking at Montserrat!
text: Pere is a great mountain guide and led us on a wonderful hike to a view point, but even more wonderfully through the mountains and forests of Montserrat Natural Park. The scenery is just spectacular. These mountains are steep, but Pere will give you multiple options with varying levels of challenge and will talk you through which one is best for you/ your group. Pere is friendly and informative and even walked through the art museum near the monastery with us before we headed back to Barcelona. And he also took photos of us throughout the day. So lovely! We really had a wonderful day. Definite
author: Marjorie555

title: Don’t miss this hike!! Book it now!
text: I cannot say enough good things about this hike. Well worth the money. I’ve paid more for this kind of outing and gotten less. Our guide was phenomenal. He considered our pace. He took us all over the mountain.  He took pictures of us at many of the lookouts! He also mentioned that he does hikes in the Pyrenees. If I come back to Barcelona, I’ll definitely book a tour with him again.
author: Luanne_H
